name: Private Sector Rent Statistics, Scotland

measures.definition: Mean monthly rent of one-bedroom homes in the Broad Rental Market Area over the year to September, mostly advertised rents of homes let that year.
Mean monthly rent of three-bedroom homes in the Broad Rental Market Area over the year to September, mostly advertised rents of homes let that year.

rights.edition: Private Sector Rent Statistics, Scotland, 2010 to 2025 (published 25 November 2025), open-data CSV
rights.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0: Scottish Government, Private Sector Rent Statistics, Scotland

vetted.notes: Official, by bedrooms; the page footer puts all content under OGL v3. ONS publishes Scotland only as a whole, so Edinburgh comes from here.

caveats: The Lothian area also holds Midlothian and East Lothian, where rents are lower than in Edinburgh, so the figure is a little below the city's own.
